title: Fast Copy is disabled for the dataflow
evidence: computeEngineSettings.allowFastCopy = false. Fast-copy capable queries: RawFiles, FilesToWarehouse.
remediation: Open the dataflow > Home > Options > Scale and turn on 'Allow use of fast copy connectors'. || In the definition set computeEngineSettings.allowFastCopy = true (the default). || Keep Fast Copy queries free of non-folding transformations; put those in a second, referencing query.

title: Gateway runs the whole dataflow, including transformations
evidence: gatewayObjectId set; queries mixing source + transformations: FactSales, RawFiles, FilesToWarehouse, Orphan.
remediation: Dataflow A (gateway): copy on-premises data to a Lakehouse/Warehouse, Fast Copy where supported, no transformations. || Dataflow B (cloud, no gateway): read the landed data and apply transformations. || Alternatively use a pipeline Copy activity/Copy job via the gateway for the movement step.

title: Heavy transformations run in the mashup engine without staging
evidence: Query 'FactSales' (staging off) uses Table.AddIndexColumn, Table.Buffer, Table.Group, Table.Sort on a non-folding path.
remediation: Right-click the first non-folding step > Extract previous, name the new query, and enable staging on it. || Apply the heavy transformations in the second query (staging on the second query is optional). || Re-check folding indicators: the first query should show green (folds to source). || Sources that never fold (Excel, CSV, JSON, web, SharePoint) benefit most: land the raw data in query 1, then transform in staging compute; prefer Parquet/Delta over CSV/Excel as the landing format.

title: Row-by-row calls to external sources (N+1 pattern)
evidence: 'FactSales' calls Web.Contents inside a row-level function.
remediation: Replace per-row calls with a single set-based call and join/merge the result. || For REST APIs, paginate with List.Generate once, or move ingestion to a pipeline Copy activity / Spark notebook. || Stage the lookup table and merge instead of invoking a function per row.

title: Event/streaming source is a better fit for Eventstream
evidence: Query 'Telemetry' reads an event/streaming source (EventHubs.Contents) through a scheduled dataflow.
remediation: Create an Eventstream with the same source and route to Eventhouse or Lakehouse. || Keep a Dataflow Gen2 / Spark job only for downstream business transformations, reading the landed table. || Retire the scheduled dataflow once parity is validated.

title: Warehouse destination without staging
evidence: Query 'FilesToWarehouse' writes to a Warehouse with staging disabled.
remediation: Enable staging on queries that load to a Warehouse destination.

title: Consumes data through the Dataflow connector
evidence: Query 'DimCustomer' reads through PowerPlatform.Dataflows.
remediation: Give the upstream dataflow a Lakehouse/Warehouse destination and read that table (Lakehouse.Contents / SQL endpoint).

title: Table.Buffer / List.Buffer used
evidence: Query 'FactSales' uses Table.Buffer.
remediation: Remove the buffer unless profiling shows a benefit. || Stage the data instead; the staging SQL engine handles large intermediate results.

title: Split into Copy job ingestion + Dataflow Gen2 transformation
evidence: Movement and heavy transformation are mixed in the same dataflow: RawFiles, FilesToWarehouse.
remediation: Stage 1: ingestion-only query (or Copy job) -> Lakehouse. || Stage 2: referencing query/dataflow/notebook applies Group/Join/Sort logic. || Wire both in a pipeline so stage 2 starts only after stage 1 succeeds.

title: File-combine queries could use Partitioned Compute
evidence: Query 'RawFiles' combines files from AzureStorage.DataLake without partitioned compute.
remediation: Options > Scale > 'Allow use of partitioned compute' and Privacy > 'Allow combining data from multiple sources'. || Re-run the Combine files experience so a Table.ReplacePartitionKey step is generated; keep the partition column in the query. || Stage the query and load directly to staging or a Fabric Warehouse for best results (Preview; each partition is billed for its own duration, so CU can be similar or higher while wall-clock drops).

title: Fast Copy source loads directly to a non-Lakehouse destination
evidence: Query 'FilesToWarehouse' (Fast Copy connector) writes straight to warehouse without staging.
remediation: Stage the ingestion query (no destination). || Create a referencing query that carries the Warehouse / SQL / KQL destination.

title: Staged output is only reachable through the Dataflow connector
evidence: Query 'DimCustomer' is staged but has no destination and no referencing query.
remediation: Add a Lakehouse or Warehouse data destination to the query. || Point reports/pipelines at the destination table instead of the Dataflow connector.

title: Staged output is only reachable through the Dataflow connector
evidence: Query 'Telemetry' is staged but has no destination and no referencing query.
remediation: Add a Lakehouse or Warehouse data destination to the query. || Point reports/pipelines at the destination table instead of the Dataflow connector.

title: Design-time row limit left in the query
evidence: Step 'Top' limits rows with a literal (Table.FirstN(Grouped, 1000)).
remediation: Replace hard-coded limits with a parameter (for example DesignDateFilter) whose value is widened for production runs. || Use Schema view to design without loading data.

title: Full reload (Replace) of a source table on every refresh
evidence: Query 'FactSales' reloads fully into lakehouse and references date/time columns.
remediation: Right-click the query > Incremental refresh; pick a Date/DateTime column, bucket size and window; make sure the query fully folds. || Use a fixed-schema Lakehouse/Warehouse/Azure SQL destination with update method Replace. || If the source cannot fold, use the incremental amassing pattern (tutorial) or a Copy job with watermark/CDC.

title: Rows are filtered late in the query
evidence: First filter is step 10 but a heavier step occurs at step 6 ('Buffered').
remediation: Move Table.SelectRows (date/ID filters) directly after the source navigation. || Combine with a Date-parameter filter to also keep design-time previews small.

title: Rows are filtered late in the query
evidence: First filter is step 4 but a heavier step occurs at step 3 ('Grouped').
remediation: Move Table.SelectRows (date/ID filters) directly after the source navigation. || Combine with a Date-parameter filter to also keep design-time previews small.

title: Repetitive type/rename/add-column steps
evidence: Query 'FactSales' has 3 separate Table.TransformColumnTypes steps.
remediation: Merge consecutive type changes into one Table.TransformColumnTypes call and renames into one Table.RenameColumns.

title: Dynamic schema destination
evidence: Query 'FactSales' uses DynamicSchema = true.
remediation: Switch the destination mapping to fixed schema (manual mapping) where schema is stable.

title: Unused query
evidence: Query 'RawFiles' is not loaded, has no destination and is not referenced.
remediation: Delete the query or document why it is kept.

title: Unused query
evidence: Query 'Orphan' is not loaded, has no destination and is not referenced.
remediation: Delete the query or document why it is kept.

title: V-Order is applied to the staging Lakehouse
evidence: enableVorder is not set (default on) and staging is in use.
remediation: Options > Scale > Staged Data > turn off 'Enable V-Order compression' (enableVorder = false) for most dataflows. || Keep V-Order for the Lakehouse destination itself when Direct Lake / SQL endpoint / Spark read it (destination-level option).

title: Low maxConcurrency with many independent queries
evidence: maxConcurrency = 1 with 6 independent queries.
remediation: Raise 'Maximum concurrent evaluations' (Options > Scale; computeEngineSettings.maxConcurrency) gradually while watching source throttling. || Incremental refresh to a Lakehouse supports at most 10 concurrent bucket evaluations.

title: Modern Evaluator is not enabled
evidence: allowModernEvaluationEngine is not set in the definition (enabled by default only for newly created CI/CD items; older items may still use the standard engine). Verify under Options > Scale.
remediation: Dataflow editor > Home > Options > Scale > turn on 'Modern query evaluation engine', then save and run. || Definition setting: computeEngineSettings.allowModernEvaluationEngine = true. || Note: Db2, Informix and MQ connectors still route to the standard engine.

title: No parameter limits design-time data previews
evidence: 4 source query(ies) and no parameter query in the dataflow.
remediation: Manage parameters > add e.g. DesignDateFilter (DateTime) and filter large tables by it. || Switch to Schema view when only the structure is needed. || Widen the parameter value before running in production.

title: Append destination without a visible incremental/dedup pattern
evidence: Query 'FilesToWarehouse' appends without reading back the destination to bound the filter.
remediation: Use native incremental refresh (Replace per bucket) instead of Append. || If you must append, filter the source to rows newer than the max timestamp already in the destination, and deduplicate downstream.

title: Transformation workload is a better fit for Spark
evidence: Signals: 7 heavy operations (Table.AddIndexColumn, Table.Buffer, Table.Combine, Table.Group, Table.Sort).
remediation: Land sources with Copy job / Fast Copy into Lakehouse Delta tables (bronze). || Re-implement the heavy queries in a notebook (Spark SQL/PySpark), writing silver/gold Delta tables. || Keep Dataflow Gen2 for light business-user shaping of the gold tables if needed. || Orchestrate with a Data Pipeline; use incremental MERGE for fact tables; validate row counts against the dataflow output.
